open_points.subject: assemble_mapped_lists
open_points.text: - assemble_mapped_lists: [BEHAVIOR] MUST build, for each MappedList in the order given, the list its elements' outputs make in element order, and write and publish nothing: a value list is one StoredValue whose bytes are canonical_bytes of the list of the elements' values — each read with read_value_bytes —, whose value_schema is the canonical array schema with the port's stored schema (M21: its value_schema, or for a many port the canonical array schema with it as items) as items, of the class highest_disclosure_class gives for the elements' StoredValues — read through read_records with one RecordsById naming their value_ids —, its value_digest content_identity of a BytesContent holding the bytes and value_id content_identity of the StoredValueContent; a file list is one SpooledFilesRef listing every element's files in element order, whose disclosure_class is the highest class among the elements' SpooledFilesRefs.
open_points.other_text: - MappedList fields (exact, no others exist): port: str, elements: tuple[PortRef, ...]
open_points.question: The required schema depends on the port's value_schema and cardinality, but MappedList contains only the port name and element references; must MappedList provide the Port metadata, or must the requirement define how the stored schema is derived from the referenced elements?
